data.one_liner: A Flutter/Dart library for reactive, offline‑first data models with built‑in Riverpod integration.
data.what_it_does: Flutter Data lets you define data models that automatically sync with local SQLite storage and remote REST endpoints. It generates adapters and providers so you can watch, query, and mutate data reactively via Riverpod.
use_when: You need offline‑first persistence with reactive UI updates
You want a unified API for local SQLite and remote REST without writing boilerplate
You are already using Riverpod for state management
avoid_when: You prefer a pure NoSQL or key‑value store without relational features
You need Web support only (Flutter Web is still TBD)
You want a minimal package without code generation
strengths: Automatic code‑gen of adapters and providers
Seamless Riverpod integration and reactive watchers
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation step
Flutter Web not fully supported yet
Complex API may be overkill for simple key‑value storage
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_data and build_runner to pubspec, run `flutter pub run build_runner build`, configure a LocalStorage provider via Riverpod overrides, optionally generate adapter map with `main.data.dart`.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides state‑management without the storage layer; lighter if you only need reactive state

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Same as Riverpod but with Flutter‑specific extensions

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers predictable state management without built‑in persistence; can be combined with separate storage solutions
